programme.title: 2026 Elite Season
programme.desc: The Top 10 anglers take to the water for Championship Sunday, chasing victory on one of the premier smallmouth fisheries in the world. Every fish matters as the battle for the blue trophy reaches its dramatic conclusion.

programme.title: 2026 Elite Season
programme.desc: The season-ending showdown comes down to the scales in Clayton as the finalists bring their best catches to weigh-in. Witness the crowning of the tournament champion and the final chapter of an unforgettable week on the St. Lawrence River.

programme.title: Jason Christie - Instinct Over Time
programme.desc: Despite his 30-plus years of tournament fishing, Jason Christie was delighted to admit he was wrong about the Mountain Dew Bassmaster Elite at Tennessee-Tombigbee Waterway.

programme.title: Bryan Schmitt - The Champlain Champ
programme.desc: With a four-day total of 81 pounds, 7 ounces, Bryan Schmitt takes another win on Lake Champlain! An 18-13 final-day bag was enough to seal the deal by a one-pound margin at the SPRO Bassmaster Elite at Lake Champlain!

programme.title: Jacob Foutz - All or Nothing
programme.desc: Family’s important to Jacob Foutz, so when he made a promise to his great grandmother Judy Fisher, he intended to keep it. Two years after her passing, Foutz fulfilled his oath.

programme.title: Paul Marks - Herring King
programme.desc: Paul Marks’ day did not begin the way he’d wanted, but it ended the way he’d dreamed. The difference — a gut call that changed his trajectory and put a second blue trophy on his mantle, this one from the Tedy’s Team Bassmaster Elite at Lake Murray.

programme.title: Chris Johnston - No Sonar
programme.desc: Johnston not only secured his second Elite Series win, following his 2020 triumph on the St. Lawrence River, but also captured his second Century Belt, becoming the third angler to earn the distinction on both smallmouth and largemouth fisheries.

programme.title: Evan Kung - Win Or Go Home
programme.desc: Evan Kung entered the Lowrance Bassmaster Elite at the St. Lawrence River in danger of losing his spot on the Progressive Bassmaster Elite Series for 2027. Not only did he save his spot, the Canadian won his first B.A.S.S. trophy in record-setting fashion.

programme.title: Dylan Nutt - One Nation, One Dream
programme.desc: Bass Nation angler Dylan Nutt turns a grassroots opportunity into history, landing huge bags on Tennessee waters and becoming the first Nation competitor in 32 years to win the Bassmaster Classic.

programme.title: Fisher Anaya - One More Fish
programme.desc: Winning a Progressive Bassmaster Elite Series event is something Anaya always dreamed about doing, and achieving that goal at the Lippert Bassmaster Elite at Lake Martin left him wanting more.

programme.desc: At no point did Jason Christie think he was going to win the Maxam Bassmaster Elite Series at Pasquotank River/Albemarle Sound. That is, until he held the trophy over his head.
